desc.zh: 测量地块、钉桩、拉线，标出退界。
desc.en: Survey the lot, set stakes and strings, mark setbacks.
Dig pits and trenches where the footings go.

desc.zh: 每根柱下浇一块独立基础。
desc.en: An isolated footing pad under every column.

desc.zh: 柱从基础长出来，地梁把各柱底部连成一体。
desc.en: Columns rise from the pads; foundation beams tie them together.

desc.zh: 一层地坪、二层梁板、二层柱和楼梯。
desc.en: Ground slab, 2nd-floor beams and slab, upper columns, stairs.

desc.zh: 空心砖/加气砖砌筑，留门窗洞。
desc.en: CHB / AAC masonry with door and window openings.

desc.zh: 屋架、檩条、屋面，锚固要抗台风。
desc.en: Trusses, purlins and roofing, tied down against typhoons.

desc.zh: 下沉式钢筋混凝土池壳、防水、贴砖。
desc.en: In-ground RC shell, waterproofing and tiles.

desc.zh: 墙面材料、地面、门窗全部到位。
desc.en: Wall finishes, flooring, doors and windows in place.
